description: Run a transaction simulation and EVM safety preflight with gas, destination proxy evidence, and optional token security and allowance checks in one decision-ready report. Price: 0.005 USDC. Mode: live_source. Source: public EVM JSON-RPC and optional GoPlus Token Security API. Set auto_pay=true for a one-call purchase when the local buyer wallet is configured.

auto_pay.description: Automatically authorize and pay this request with the locally configured buyer wallet. Requires X402_AUTO_PAY=true and X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

chain.description: base, ethereum, or arbitrum; defaults to base.

payment_id.description: payment_id returned by the x402 invoice.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE produced by a compatible buyer client.

preview.description: Inspect a rate-limited live contract proof showing source, freshness, response shape, and required inputs. Decision-ready values remain in the paid result.

spender.description: Optional spender for allowance evidence when from and token_contract are supplied.

token_contract.description: Optional token contract for GoPlus security evidence.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash after paying an x402 invoice.

name: transaction_preflight
